interpretation.current_anchor: clean-Qwen same-window second view remains the only replicated positive mechanism, but it spends about half of pair-row words on generated rewrites of near-original length and often high lexical overlap.
interpretation.next_route_implication: At a fixed same-window pair budget, a second view with generated length 0.35-0.65x of the original could expose many more distinct official originals and relations if semantic fidelity can be filtered; this motivates transformation-family screens rather than another optimizer/masking/tokenizer knob.
